status: fixed BEFORE the settings grid was run; seen before writing: the experiment A / B / C-weight / D replays at batch-2 settings (h = 1)

grid.post_geometry: reported in the grid, never selectable (designed after seeing cup B)
grid.scenes: all 32 development scenes (16 primary A/B/C, 16 additional dev family with own records removed)

settings_rule.criterion: per family at budget 64, REPLAY: 1. successes within 3 attempts of the updating member (A3 resp. A5, update weight 1, no_repeat), 2. first-attempt successes, both pooled over the 32 scenes x 3 selections; ties go to the batch-2 setting (h = 1, representation geometry)
settings_rule.use: the chosen settings are used for every later development comparison, the fresh-execution verification, experiment C online and the locked test; the h = 1 replays stay reported as the pre-registered primary result

budget_rule: initialization batch: for each family, the smallest budget in {0, 16, 64} whose within-3 successes (updating member, chosen settings, pooled over scenes x selections) are at most 3 below the best of {0, 16, 64}; 256 is a reference only
e2_rule: E2 = the better of A1 (one correction) and A2 (ranked search) at their chosen budget: within-3 successes, then first-attempt; ties to the simpler (A1)
e3: E3 = the contextual updating S1 (A5) with the chosen representation, h, budget, update weight and retry rule
update_weight_rule: conservative weight from the noisy development replay (expC_weight_summary.json); chosen 0.25 at batch-2 settings
retry_rule: chosen after experiment C online: the rule with more successes within 3 attempts for the E3 configuration; ties to no_repeat

amendment_1.before: any fresh execution, any Astra call, any locked-cup access
amendment_1.why: the family rule set the context-free bandwidth from A3's within-3 count (h = 1: 93 vs 92 of 96), which costs A1/A2 seven first-attempt successes (77 vs 84 of 96) that E2 would inherit; settings are now chosen per role, by the member that will be used
amendment_1.rule: E2 candidates (A1, A2): h by A2's within-3, then A1/A2's first-attempt successes; E3 (A5): representation and h by A5's within-3, then A4/A5's first-attempt successes (identical first picks); budget 64, replay, pooled over 32 scenes x 3 selections; ties to the batch-2 setting
